1) NDA (mutual) first — quick signature to allow information exchange. Target turnaround: 3 business days for review and signature. We'll send our standard NDA to Acme and request their template if they prefer.

- NDA: Rishi/Laura (legal) — aim to get signed quickly.
- DPA: Laura (contracts) with Security input as needed.
- MSA: Laura with commercial input from Neha; finance (Stephanie) if there are exceptions on payment terms or credits.
